io.github.thatgarlicdude.pacromset.manifest

Class PacROMSetManifestEntry

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thatgarlicdude.pacromset.manifest.PacROMSetManifestEntry

  • public final class PacROMSetManifestEntry
extends java.lang.Object
    A class that represents an entry in a Pac-Man ROM set manifest.

    These can be found in a list object inside of a PacROMSetManifest instance. An entry in a Pac-Man ROM set manifest only contains the expected name and size found in a Pac-Man ROM set. They do not contain ROM data whatsoever, as it is material protected by copyright. In addition to this, the class itself is immutable, meaning that its fields cannot be changed by any means. If the class wants to have its fields altered, it can create a new instance using a changed variable by calling its with methods.

    Since:
    1.0.0
    See Also:
    PacROMSetManifest

    • Field Detail

      • MAX_SIZE

        public static final int MAX_SIZE
        The the maximum size of a manifest entry.

        This field is used to ensure that, when a manifest entry is being constructed via PacROMSetManifestEntry(String, int), the size parameter doesn't go out of bounds. It is also done because of the limitations when reading and writing Pac-Man ROM set manifest files from disk.

        Since:
        1.0.0
        See Also:
        getMaxSize(), Constant Field Values

      • MIN_SIZE

        The the minimum size of a manifest entry.

        This field is used to ensure that, when a manifest entry is being constructed via PacROMSetManifestEntry(String, int), the size parameter doesn't go out of bounds. It is also done because of the limitations when reading and writing Pac-Man ROM set manifest files from disk.

        Since:

        See Also:

      • NAME_TERMINATOR

        public static final int NAME_TERMINATOR
        The number that represents a terminator for a manifest entry's name.

        This field is used by the IO classes, PacROMSetManifestReader and PacROMSetManifestWriter. When a Pac-Man ROM set manifest is being written as a file to disk, this number will be written as a byte at the end of a name in a manifest entry. When the file is being read, the number is used to indicate the ending point of an entry name and proceed with other data in the file.

        Since:
        1.0.0
        See Also:
        getNameTerminator(), Constant Field Values

    • Constructor Detail

      • PacROMSetManifestEntry

        public PacROMSetManifestEntry(java.lang.String name,
                              int size)
        Constructs an instance of the PacROMSetManifestEntry class.

        When constructing an instance of this class, the name cannot be null. In addition, the size must be within the range of 0 and 65535. If these parameters don't meet the requirements, it will throw an error saying that the name is null or the size is out of range.

        Also, as a note: The name parameter is the expected filename found in a Pac-Man ROM set (directory or ZIP file). An example for this would be pacman.6e, pm1_prg1.6e, or 82s123.7f.

        Parameters:
        name - The name of the manifest entry.
        size - The size of the manifest entry.
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - When the name is null.
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - When the size is out of range.
        Since:
        1.0.0
